result.reason: The clause adds a mutual aggregate cap, the USD 1,000,000 floor, and all preferred carve-outs, but it does not use the required fee-based formulation. It instead measures the cap by all amounts paid or payable between the Parties, which may materially exceed 12 months’ fees, and uses the period preceding the event rather than the claim. It also excludes all amounts owed by either Party under Section 5 from the cap, rather than only Customer payment obligations. Those expansions go beyond what is needed and prevent the language from cleanly reaching either the preferred or fallback position. Otherwise, the amendment is generally clear and preserves the clause’s unrelated commercial intent, although the retained punctuation error and ambiguous cross-reference reduce drafting quality.
